t: A keychain-size color game console you can program in MicroPython.
steps: Buy a Thumby Color from TinyCircuits or Maker Shed.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Open the browser code editor on the official Thumby Color site in Chrome or Edge.
Connect the console over USB-C and let the editor find it.
Load a community game and play it.
Open the code of a simple example and change a number, such as a sprite's speed.
Try Thonny with MicroPython for a steadier file workflow.
meta: Open Code. From $49.95. A few stores.
